basic_details.job_title: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 AV Technician, Network Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IITH), an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is filling 8 contractual posts under Advertisement No. IITH/CS/62: HPC System Engineer, Network Engineer, Web Developer, System Engineer and AV Technician. The engagement is initially for 11 months, with consolidated remuneration of Rs.30,000/- to Rs.80,000/- per month depending on the post. Eligible Indian nationals must apply online through the link given against each post on careers.iith.ac.in. Online applications began on 10 November 2026 and close on 1

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted online only, using the link against each position. The notice says offline applications, if submitted, will be summarily rejected, and a printout of the online form need not be submitted to the Institute. The online form is available through the link under Temporary Positions at https://iith.ac.in/careers/, and Annexure-I gives the form-filling instructions.

Register on the online application portal with a valid and active email ID. It must remain functional throughout the recruitment process, as call letters, notifications and updates are sent only to this ID.

Fill in the personal information: name as in the 10th Standard/Matriculation certificate, date of birth with valid proof, mobile number, address, category, and Yes/No details for ex-servicemen, PwBD and any pending criminal or disciplinary case.
Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, 1 MB, taken within the last one month) and the signature in the same way.
Click "Save & Next", then use "Add Education" to enter qualifications and upload certificates in PDF format (maximum 1 MB per document).
Use "Add Employment" to enter employment details and upload supporting documents in PDF format (maximum 1 MB per document). Additional relevant certificates can be added with "Add Certificate".
Open "Review & Submit", verify the details, accept the declaration by selecting the checkbox, and submit. A PDF copy of the application is generated and sent to the registered email ID.
Photograph and signature in JPG/JPEG, 1 MB each.
Proof of date of birth (10th Standard Certificate/Mark Sheet/Birth Certificate).

Experience certificates on the organisation's letterhead, showing designation, period of service, nature of work assignment(s) and pay, with the date of issue, and the name, designation, signature and stamp of the issuing authority.

For SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates, the certificate in the prescribed Government of India format: OBC certificates must show Non-Creamy Layer, a Central List entry and issue within the last two years; the EWS certificate must be for the current financial year.
Ex-servicemen certificate, and a PwBD certificate indicating a disability of 40% or more, where applicable.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Hyderabad
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located at Kandi, Sangareddy, Telangana. The notice describes it as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its website is www.iith.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 8 vacancies across 5 posts. It calls the number of advertised posts tentative: the actual number may increase or decrease depending on the requirement.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. Educational qualifications must have been obtained from a recognized Board/Council/University/Institute. The cut-off date for reckoning the upper age limit, qualification and post qualification experience is the last date of online submission, 01-12-2026. Only relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree or course is counted; part-time employment experience is not considered. Criteria-1: Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc/MCA) in Computer Science/IT/Software Engineering/Artificial Intelligence/Data Science from a recognized institution with a minimum of 1 year of post qualification relevant experience. OR Criteria-2: Diploma in Computer Science, Electronics, Communication/IT/Software Engineering/Artificial Intelligence/Data Science from a recognized institution (ITI/NTC) with a minimum of 2 years of post qualification relevant experience. For the Network Engineer post, candidates with qualifications higher than those specified under the Minimum Educational Qualification are not eligible to apply. Relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable as per GoI rules; the notice does not list the relaxation by category. Age is counted as on 01-12-2026. In the case of a highly meritorious candidate, the selection committee may relax any experience criteria. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a contractual, temporary basis for 11 months. Further extension, if any, may be granted subject to satisfactory performance and the requirement of the Institute. The appointment can be terminated at any time during the contract period with one month's notice from either side. The notice states that no right or claim to employment at IITH arises from this temporary engagement. Consolidated remuneration per month is subject to statutory deductions, as applicable. Working hours are 8 hours per day, 6 days a week. The appointee is required to work on weekends and holidays as and when informed by the Head of the Department/Faculty-in-Charge/Chairperson. Contractual employees are not eligible for campus residential accommodation. The Institute may consider allotment case to case, depending on the essentiality of services, availability of accommodation and payment of the licence fee at an appropriate rate. Medical facilities are limited to outpatient treatment (OPD) during medical emergencies, at Rs. 100/- for normal OPD and Rs. 200/- for Specialists (rates subject to change). No reimbursement of medical expenses is admissible. The selected candidate must hold a valid health insurance policy for the engagement period, obtained at their own expense, and submit a copy at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists key responsibilities and the skills required for each post, as follows. Key Responsibilities: Install, configure, and maintain HPC clusters and related infrastructure. Manage and administer Linux-based systems (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu). Configure and manage workload schedulers such as Slurm. Monitor cluster performance, job queues, and resource utilisation. Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues in HPC environments. Manage storage systems (NFS, Lustre, GPFS, or similar parallel file systems). Handle user account management, permissions, and access control. Ensure system security, patching, and compliance with policies. Automate routine tasks using scripting (E.g., Bash, Python). Support users in job submission, debugging, and optimisation. Maintain documentation for system architecture and procedures. Coordinate with vendors for hardware/software support and upgrades. Skills Required: Strong experience with Linux system administration. Hands-on experience with Slurm or other job schedulers (PBS, Torque, LSF). Experience with GPU computing environments (NVIDIA CUDA, drivers, etc.). Familiarity with storage technologies (RAID, SAN, NAS, parallel file systems). Knowledge of container technologies (Docker, Singularity/Apptainer). Knowledge of networking concepts (TCP/IP, InfiniBand, etc.). Experience with cluster provisioning and configuration tools. Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar. Understanding of security best practices in Linux environments. Exposure to configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef). Experience with monitoring tools (Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana). Familiarity with cloud-based HPC environments. Basic knowledge of MPI, OpenMP, and scientific workloads. Job Responsibilities (non-exhaustive, subject to change): Monitor and support the campus LAN, Wi-Fi, and fiber-optic network infrastructure. Troubleshoot and resolve L2-level network connectivity issues related to switches, Wi-Fi Access Points, VLANs, PoE, and network links. Analyse network faults and identify the root cause using network monitoring systems, switch logs, interface statistics, and troubleshooting tools. Perform basic configuration and troubleshooting of managed network switches. Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, access ports, trunk ports, PoE, port security, and basic Layer-2 network parameters. Monitor the health and availability of Wi-Fi Access Points and wireless network infrastructure through the respective network management platform. Troubleshoot Wi-Fi issues such as AP connectivity, uplink failure, PoE issues, high utilisation, intermittent connectivity, and client connectivity problems. Monitor and troubleshoot fiber-optic links, including link status, optical power, fiber connectivity, and interface errors. Coordinate with L1 technicians on LAN cabling, fiber, racks, APs, and other physical infrastructure issues. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice gives the mode of selection as Written Test/Skill Test/Interview, with the venue as IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy. The dates of these stages are not specified in the notice. Call letters and updates are sent to the registered email ID. Candidates are allowed to attend the selections based on the information in their online applications. The Institute decides the mode of screening and testing for shortlisting and selection. It also reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called, based on qualifications, level and relevance of experience higher than the minimum prescribed and other academic achievements. Calling a candidate for a test or interview does not assure that the candidate will be recommended or selected. Candidates must produce self-attested copies of all certificates (educational/caste/experience) along with the originals for verification at the time of interview, written test or skill test. No Travelling Allowance (TA)/DA is paid for attending the selections.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: HPC System Engineer 2, Network Engineer 3, Web Developer 1, System Engineer 1 and AV Technician 1. The notice calls the number of posts tentative.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 01-12-2026 (1 December 2026). Online applications began on 10-11-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Hyderabad HPC System Engineer post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc.) or Master's degree (M.E / M.Tech / MCA) in Computer Science/IT/Information Science/Software Engineering/Artificial Intelligence/Data Science from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the AV Technician post?
faq.answer: Either a Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc/MCA) in the listed computer disciplines with a minimum of 1 year of post qualification relevant experience, or a Diploma in the listed disciplines (ITI/NTC) with a minimum of 2 years of post qualification relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIT Hyderabad contractual posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for HPC System Engineer and 35 years for the other four posts, counted as on 01-12-2026. Relaxation is applicable as per GoI rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Consolidated remuneration per month is Rs.35,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- for HPC System Engineer, Rs.30,000/- to Rs. 45,000/- for Network Engineer, Rs.30,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- for Web Developer and System Engineer, and Rs.32,000/- for AV Technician. It is subject to statutory deductions.
